title: tragacantha albicans
intro: Tragacantha albicans, commonly known as Thorny Milk Vetch, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the legume family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha albicans include soothing irritated tissues, reducing pain, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
